tasks.registered_metrics_text:
a) Define the metric(s) to assess a property of an algorithm. These metrics should reflect the desired algorithm
properties described in assessment aim(s) (see above). State which metric(s) were used to compute the ranking(s) (if
any).
  • Example 1: Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC)
  • Example 2: Area under curve (AUC)
Accuracy, Precision, Sensitivity, Specificity, F1-score, Area under curve (AUC), Precision-Recall AUC, Mean of
Sensitivity and Specificity (MSS).

b) Justify why the metric(s) was/were chosen, preferably with reference to the biomedical application.

1) Accuracy: It simply measures how often the classifier correctly predicts and is a single number to
summarize the model's capability.
2) Precision: Precision provides a measure of the ability of the model to identify the positive class.
3) Sensitivity: Sensitivity provides a measure of the total positive results correctly classified by the model.
4) Specificity: Sensitivity provides a measure of the total negative results correctly classified by the model.
5) F1-score: F1-score takes both recall and precision into consideration.
6) AUC: AUC measures performance over all potential classification thresholds.
7) Precision-Recall AUC: a single number summary of the information in the precision-recall (PR) curve



 Automated prediction of treatment effectiveness in ovarian cancer using histopathological Images

8) MSS: Mean of the sensitivity and specificity.
tasks.registered_ranking_text:
a) Describe the method used to compute a performance rank for all submitted algorithms based on the generated
metric results on the test cases. Typically the text will describe how results obtained per case and metric are aggregated
to arrive at a final score/ranking.

Ranking will be according to the Mean of sensitivity and specificity on the independent testing set.

b) Describe the method(s) used to manage submissions with missing results on test cases.

Missing results will be treated as failures in prediction of the cases.

c) Justify why the described ranking scheme(s) was/were used.

The mean of sensitivity and specificity will provide a balanced idea of how well the model is predicting the
positive and the negative class for the given task.
